Question 14

Given that y=(x+1)2x2+1, find dydx.

a
2(1−x)(x2+1)2
b
2(x+1)(x2+1)2
c
(1−x)2(x2+1)2
d
2(1−x2)(x2+1)2
e
(1−2x2)(x2+1)2
